{{Quote|It's time to assign you to another quadrant. The Lucent Ivaya is now safe.|[[Laetin A'shera]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:AtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Assassinating the Assassin|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Lucent Ivaya''' was a quadrant of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. It contained the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], the [[Station Gamma]],<ref name="SWG:SfBS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Searching for Black Sun|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> the [[Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt]], the [[H-5 70 Mining Facility]]<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escorting the Dynath Miner Back To the Station|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> and the [[Lurid Aurora Nebula]].<ref name="SWG:AtA" />

==History==
{{Quote|We need to tell our allies, the Dynathians, that the Black Sun activity has increased greatly.|Laetin A'shera, to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:WtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Warning the Allies|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Lucent Ivaya was considered as the safest quadrant of the Bright Jewel system. It was frequented by civilian ships heading to and from [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] as well as [[Dynath Miners|Dynathian]] [[Unidentified transport class|mining transports]], and patrolled by [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="SWG:SfBS" /> During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] raided the quadrant and targeted Dynathian and Car'das forces. [[Laetin A'shera]] dispatched pilots who successfully repelled the Black Sun starfighters.<ref name="SWG:SfBS" /><ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" /><ref name="SWG:WtA" /><ref name="SWG:AtA" />
